{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Emerald Green Wool Blazer tailored with structured shoulders, cropped at the hip line in a sharp emerald green (#059462), made of heavy wool.
Cream Silk Shell Shirt loose-fitting with a slightly dropped shoulder, falling to mid-hip length in a soft cream (#f5f5dc), crafted from smooth silk.
Charcoal Grey Wool Trousers high-waisted with a straight leg, reaching the ankle in a deep charcoal grey (#36454f), composed of fine wool.
Tan Leather Loafers classic square-toe design with a low block heel, sized to fit her foot comfortably in a warm tan (#d2b48c), made of supple leather.
Gold Vermeil Necklace delicate chain with small geometric charms, finished in gold vermeil (#ffd700).

This outfit works by balancing the structured elegance of the autumn theatre evening with the relaxed warmth requested for an indoor performance under artificial light. The emerald green blazer adds a vibrant, artistic pop against the neutral skin tones and cream shirt, while the straight-leg wool trousers provide a sophisticated silhouette suitable for moving through a playhouse. Completing the look with comfortable tan loafers honors the refusal against high heels, ensuring she can focus on enjoying the performance without discomfort."}
